info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Diagnosis API
info.description: The Fraud Diagnosis API is designed for the assessment and identification of potential fraudulent activities within banking accounts. It leverages advanced algorithms to analyze transaction patterns and detect anomalies, ensuring the security of customer accounts. This API is typically used by financial institutions and risk management teams to enhance their fraud prevention strategies. By integrating with this API, users can automate the fraud detection process, enabling timely interventions to protect assets.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed fraud diagnosis information related to accounts. It provides insights into fraudulent activities that may affect account integrity, helping users make informed decisions and take necessary actions.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a fraud diagnosis check on a given account. The request should contain data necessary for analyzing potential fraud activities.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning fraud diagnosis information.

GetFraudDiagnosisRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the fraud diagnosis API.
